text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Serum sickness-like reaction (drug-induced hypersensitivity). Based on the temporal relationship with antibiotics, the presence of fever, arthralgia, and an itchy rash without specific urticaria or systemic organ failure signs, this clinical picture is most consistent with serum sickness-like reaction rather than true serum sickness or other autoimmune etiologies.
